title: An Asia payments group starts writing rules for agentic commerce
summary: The Emerging Payments Association Asia launched a 12-month AI and Agentic Commerce Working Group across six Asian markets, aiming at policy recommendations for an APEC submission in 2027. Its advisory committee includes HSBC, Mastercard, PayPal, Amazon and J.P. Morgan.
whyItMatters: Industry is drafting the rules for paying agents before regulators set them.
